marks.gloss_en: והתניא כגרוגרת -- but a baraita gives the measure for amir as a dried-fig bulk, not a lamb's mouthful
אידי ואידי חד שיעורא הוא -- the two are one and the same measure (= p_tale_grogeret_chad_shiura)
the mishna: [one who carries out] amir (ears of grain) [is liable at] a lamb's mouthful
מפני שלא שוו בשיעוריהן -- they do not combine because their measures are not equal
the mishna: and they do not combine with one another [to make up a measure]
טעמא דראויין ליטמא מושב -- since R' Shimon gives fitness for seat-impurity as the reason, without it they would not join
וכל דלא שוו בשיעורייהו מי מצטרפין? והתנן... -- the Kelim items join only because they share fitness for seat-impurity; items without such a shared basis do not join even to the lenient measure
דתניא: R' Shimon ben Elazar makes another who carries out what this one stored liable through the storer's thought -- whereas the mishna makes only the one who stores it liable
R' Elazar: this [clause: whatever is not fit to store...] is not in accordance with R' Shimon ben Elazar
מפני שלא שוו בשיעוריהן -- they do not combine because their measures are not equal
one who carries out straw [is liable at] a cow's mouthful
שפיר עבד דהדר, דהא לא חזי לגמל -- exempt, since a cow's mouthful is not fit for a camel
אדרבה, כדמעיקרא מסתברא, דהא חזי לפרה -- liable, since it is fit for a cow
Rav Yehuda: etza [of the mishna] is straw of legume species
רבי יוחנן אמר פטור -- אכילה על ידי הדחק לא שמה אכילה
ריש לקיש אמר חייב -- אכילה על ידי הדחק שמה אכילה
one who carries out etza of a cow's mouthful for a cow is exempt
